📰 ASML's 2nm Secret: Exploding Tin Droplets

ASML has unveiled a groundbreaking EUV photolithography method using exploding tin droplets to print 2nm chips, marking a significant leap in semiconductor manufacturing. This innovation redefines the limits of transistor density and performance, enabling the next generation of AI and high-performance computing.
